title: SSW ReadyToFly – Aircraft Maintenance + Dashboard Integration
status: INTEGRATED IN MAIN APP; LOTTIE ASSETS LINKED TO VERIFIED SOURCE REPOSITORY; PROFILE PROGRESS IS DEVICE-LOCAL

app_updates.details: Added dotLottie player module and Aircraft Maintenance bottom navigation route.

Loads data/aircraft-maintenance.json; adds Aircraft Maintenance book library route with original PDF viewer and per-book image gallery; dashboard now displays combined ReadyToFly identity, Aircraft Maintenance book/image counts, and three Lottie player references.
Adds Aircraft Maintenance route to shared dashboard navigation model.
Adds responsive AM book cards, PDF viewer, image gallery, Lottie dashboard layout and six-item mobile navigation.
Combined Ground Handling + Aircraft Maintenance app identity.
New cache version; caches Aircraft Maintenance manifest; optional caching for the three Lottie paths without failing installation when assets are not yet present.
Exact source PDF URLs and 196 exact image file URLs from SSW-ReadyToFly source repository, separated into AM Books 1, 2 and 3.

aircraft_maintenance_sources.source_note: Source PDFs and image assets are referenced from the audited source repository; they have not been copied or renamed in the source repository.

lottie_assets.app_strategy: Loaded from raw.githubusercontent.com source URLs; binary files remain in the source repository and are not duplicated in My-GH.

preservation: Existing Ground Handling source data and app modules were not replaced.
AM Books 1–3 remain separate books with independent PDFs and image folders.
Source audit statuses are displayed without treating near matches as exact matches.
No missing semantic/activity mapping was invented.

profiles.progress_storage: Separate localStorage key per profile on each device
profiles.legacy_progress_migration: Existing unscoped progress migrates to Male 1 on first selection if no Male 1 profile store exists
